New declassifications and competing institutional aims support E and mechanistic depth. D=8 low confidence from introduction, contents and review extracts; distinct legal/scientific conflicts add learning, full chapter yield unverified. Central US secrecy regime triggers both T11 and T12; approximate endpoint 2020 for the contemporary concluding frame. Original 2021.

Do not treat every claim as false; insider observations and cross-country cases retain some payload. D=6.5 low confidence from review and scope, independently of E.
